purpose: Review a finite historical point-in-time board structure and oversight domain before opening person rows, filings, governance values, candidate values, comparators, prices or returns.

repository_evidence.current_snapshot_boundary: Campaign114 rejected independent-director share from a current company snapshot because it is not point-in-time history; Campaign171 does not reopen that snapshot or backfill it.
repository_evidence.management_continuity_boundary: Campaign131 and Campaign160 closed stk_managers identity, departure-date, title and role reinterpretations; director turnover or tenure cannot rescue that consumed source.
repository_evidence.audit_and_vote_boundary: Audit opinion and shareholder-meeting dissent are separate terminal or deferred families; board oversight cannot relabel their values.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Historically versioned board independence, role separation, committee oversight and director skill composition are issuer governance states distinct from current snapshots, management continuity and audit outcomes, but no complete local point-in-time source contract admits them.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official filing, exchange registry or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and observation identifier
first public timestamp, effective appointment or resignation date, correction, withdrawal, replacement and trading-session availability
issuer, listed security, person and board-seat identity through name changes, multiple securities and simultaneous roles without current-state leakage
director, independent director, chair, vice-chair, general manager, acting, deputy, board secretary, supervisor and committee-role taxonomy
independence qualification, loss, objection, vacancy, grace period and exchange-specific rule semantics
chair and general-manager concurrency, interim appointment, delegated authority and group-versus-listed-issuer role semantics
audit, nomination, remuneration and strategy committee membership, chairing, meeting, attendance, abstention and dissent semantics
gender, age, education, professional skill and industry-experience categories with unknown and undisclosed values preserved
board denominator, vacancy, alternate, suspended duty, duplicate person, partial period and reporting-period semantics
missing, undisclosed, unknown, not-applicable, true zero and source omission rules without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, role, denominator and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: historical_board_independence_ratio
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: The point-in-time share of valid independent directors on the issuer board after appointment, resignation and qualification changes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted historical contract freezes person and seat identity, independence qualification, vacancy, effective versus publication time, correction chain, denominator and complete 2019-2023 coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: chair_and_general_manager_role_separation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A point-in-time governance state distinguishing separated from concurrently held chair and general-manager authority.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Acting, interim, deputy, delegated, group-level and listed-company roles plus effective/publication dates and role changes have no admitted point-in-time contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: board_committee_coverage_attendance_or_dissent_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Historically published audit, nomination, remuneration or strategy committee coverage and director participation in oversight work.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Committee taxonomy, mandatory versus voluntary scope, meetings, eligible attendance, abstention, dissent, reporting period, revision and first-public timing are not frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: board_gender_age_education_or_professional_skill_composition
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A point-in-time board composition state covering disclosed demographic and professional skill categories.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Category taxonomy, self-disclosure, unknown values, identity history, effective timing, privacy-sensitive parsing and cross-industry comparability lack an admitted contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: director_turnover_tenure_or_role_change_from_stk_managers
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Appointment, departure, tenure or title-change intensity reconstructed from the consumed management-person source.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign131 and Campaign160 expressly close title, role, identity and departure-date reinterpretation after the stk_managers source failure; selecting directors instead of managers does not create a new source contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: current_company_profile_board_snapshot_historical_backfill
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A current board snapshot copied backward to approximate historical governance states.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign114 already rejected the current-snapshot route; backward filling present directors, roles or attributes would erase historical changes and introduce look-ahead and survivorship bias.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: board_governance_score_threshold_change_peer_or_model_combination
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transformation or composite across independence, role separation, committee oversight and director composition.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing levels, changes, thresholds, peers, weights, industry filters or models before any base governance state has a complete point-in-time source would multiply hypotheses and invite taxonomy rescue.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four historically point-in-time board governance states remain deferred at source admission; management-source rescue, current-snapshot backfill and premature governance-score modeling are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions and three audit failures in the Campaign171 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
